summary.zh: 查看账目、发票与联系人

description.zh: 读取组织的科目表、发票、账单与联系人，查询账目余额。适合小企业财务核对。首次连接在浏览器登录 Xero 授权并选择组织。
description.en: Read chart of accounts, invoices, bills, and contacts, and check account balances. Useful for small business bookkeeping checks. Sign in to Xero and choose an organization on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Xero 并选择组织
authHint.en: Sign in to Xero and choose an organization on first connect
